lines.zh: 我的身体在滴，滴下的东西会蚀地。
lines.en: My body drips, and what drips eats the ground.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚就散成紫雾。
lines.en: Each step scatters my foot into purple mist.

lines.zh: 我不踩实地面，我压着它。
lines.en: I do not step on the ground; I press it down.

lines.zh: 空气在我身边发出嘶声。
lines.en: The air hisses around me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，石头变软。
lines.en: Where I walk, the stone goes soft.

lines.zh: 我的四肢断了又长，走个不停。
lines.en: My limbs break and regrow, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我拖着一道紫色的痕。
lines.en: I drag a purple streak behind me.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在雾里若隐若现。
lines.en: My ribs flicker in and out of the mist.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，所以走得没有节奏。
lines.en: I need no breath, so my walking has no rhythm.

lines.zh: 我飘一步，落地时像泼了什么。
lines.en: I float a step and land like something spilled.

lines.zh: 我身上的孔在漏气。
lines.en: The holes in me are leaking.

lines.zh: 我的影子是紫的，还带烟。
lines.en: My shadow is purple and still smoking.

lines.zh: 我站着，脚下的草已经黄了。
lines.en: I stand, and the grass beneath me has yellowed.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是一小片毒雾。
lines.en: My breath is a small patch of poison mist.

lines.zh: 我在等身体重新凝起来。
lines.en: I am waiting for my body to thicken again.

lines.zh: 我的手在滴，接不住。
lines.en: My hand drips and I cannot catch it.

lines.zh: 末地的风穿过我，我漏了一点。
lines.en: End wind passes through me and I leak a little.

lines.zh: 我记得被龙息打中的那一刻。
lines.en: I remember the instant the dragon breath hit.

lines.zh: 我数着自己还剩几块完整的皮。
lines.en: I count how many patches of skin remain whole.

lines.zh: 周围安静得能听见腐蚀声。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear the corrosion.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，吐出的不是话，是雾。
lines.en: I open my mouth and out comes mist, not speech.

lines.zh: 那只末影龙，我至今记得它的眼。
lines.en: That ender dragon; I still remember its eyes.

lines.zh: 我不睡，睡了就散。
lines.en: I do not sleep; sleeping would scatter me.

lines.zh: 我背对着黑曜石柱发呆。
lines.en: I stare away from the obsidian pillars.

lines.zh: 有只末影螨爬过我，化了。
lines.en: An endermite crawled over me and dissolved.

lines.zh: 我在试着把自己收拢。
lines.en: I am trying to gather myself back together.

lines.zh: 你戴了头盔，那没用。
lines.en: You wear a helmet; it will not help.

lines.zh: 你的护甲很厚，我照样能碰到你。
lines.en: Your armor is thick, and I still reach you.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上末地的尘。
lines.en: I know the End dust on you.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候往后缩了，对。
lines.en: You shrank back when you saw me; correct.

lines.zh: 你同伴站在你身后，他也会疼。
lines.en: Your friend stands behind you; he will hurt too.

lines.zh: 你的皮肤还完好，很快就不会了。
lines.en: Your skin is still whole; it will not stay so.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，可毒雾绕得过来。
lines.en: Hold your breath; the mist goes around.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，砍不散雾。
lines.en: That sword will not scatter mist.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在算距离，我也在。
lines.en: Your eyes measure distance; so do mine.

lines.zh: 你身上有龙息的味道，同类吗。
lines.en: You smell of dragon breath; are you kin?

lines.zh: 你在发抖，是怕还是被蚀到了。
lines.en: You tremble; is it fear or corrosion?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，直到你的护甲开始响。
lines.en: I watch until your armor starts to tick.

lines.zh: 你的刀把我切开，我又合上。
lines.en: Your blade cuts me open and I close again.

lines.zh: 我散了一块，慢慢凝回来。
lines.en: A piece of me scatters and slowly thickens back.

lines.zh: 疼，但这具身体早就不是我的。
lines.en: Pain, though this body stopped being mine long ago.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方冒出一股紫烟。
lines.en: A plume of purple smoke rises where you struck.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在化，比刚才更快。
lines.en: My edges dissolve faster than before.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起那口龙息。
lines.en: This brings back that dragon breath.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂开，里面全是雾。
lines.en: My skin splits and there is nothing inside but mist.

lines.zh: 你砍得越狠，我滴得越多。
lines.en: The harder you cut, the more I drip.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，不是怕，是散了。
lines.en: I fall back, not from fear but from scattering.

lines.zh: 别用火，火会让我彻底散开。
lines.en: Do not use fire; it would scatter me for good.

lines.zh: 你手里那瓶龙息，给我。
lines.en: That bottle of dragon breath, give it to me.

lines.zh: 末影珍珠，我闻到了。
lines.en: Ender pearl; I smell it.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的味道，靠近点。
lines.en: That is chorus fruit; come closer.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水里有我的旧身体。
lines.en: That potion holds a piece of my old body.

lines.zh: 你把珍珠放下，我就不追。
lines.en: Set the pearl down and I will not follow.

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物，是龙息。
lines.en: What I want is not food but dragon breath.

lines.zh: 你背包里那点末地尘，抖出来。
lines.en: Shake the End dust out of your pack.

lines.zh: 一滴龙息就够我凝住一会儿。
lines.en: One drop of breath would hold my shape a while.

lines.zh: 那件被蚀过的甲，给我看看。
lines.en: Show me that corroded armor piece.

lines.zh: 你举着珍珠，像举着灯。
lines.en: You hold the pearl up like a lamp.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的雾里，皮肤开始疼。
lines.en: You hit my mist and your skin starts to sting.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，紫雾糊上你的脸。
lines.en: I turn and purple mist smears your face.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，撞上来却像酸。
lines.en: My body is soft, yet it strikes like acid.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的袖子少了半边。
lines.en: With that, half your sleeve is gone.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，手上起了一片红。
lines.en: You are knocked back with a red patch on your hand.

lines.zh: 我压过去，你的甲缝在冒烟。
lines.en: I lean in and your armor seam smokes.

lines.zh: 我撞你，你的盾面开始化。
lines.en: I hit you and your shield face starts to melt.

lines.zh: 你退得太慢，雾已经贴上了。
lines.en: You retreat too slowly; the mist is on you.

lines.zh: 我的肩散了，又在你身上凝。
lines.en: My shoulder scatters, then thickens on you.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我无所谓，对你不是。
lines.en: Collisions mean nothing to me, but not to you.

lines.zh: 两具溶解的身体贴在一起会融合。
lines.en: Two dissolved bodies pressed together will merge.

lines.zh: 她也是被龙息打中的，我们认得彼此。
lines.en: She was struck by breath too; we know each other.

lines.zh: 我们交换雾，直到分不清是谁。
lines.en: We trade mist until neither of us is sure.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会是一小团紫色的雨。
lines.en: Our child would be a small rain of purple.

lines.zh: 繁殖对我们只是暂时凝住形状。
lines.en: For us breeding is only briefly holding shape.

lines.zh: 她散开时，我替她收拢。
lines.en: When she scatters, I gather her back.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，地面一起烂。
lines.en: We walk abreast and the ground rots with us.

lines.zh: 别靠近，融合时谁都会蚀到。
lines.en: Stay back; during a merge, anyone corrodes.

lines.zh: 她的孔比我少，比我完整。
lines.en: She has fewer holes and is more whole than I.

lines.zh: 我们用雾说话，你听不见。
lines.en: We speak in mist, and you cannot hear it.

lines.zh: 你捡起我掉的东西，手会麻。
lines.en: Pick up what I dropped and your hand will numb.

lines.zh: 那块皮还在腐蚀你的指尖。
lines.en: That patch of skin is still eating your fingertip.

lines.zh: 别把那滴紫液放进铁盒。
lines.en: Do not put that purple drop in an iron box.

lines.zh: 你捡起的残片有三根手指。
lines.en: The fragment you picked up has three fingers.

lines.zh: 它在你手里化了一半。
lines.en: It has half dissolved in your hand.

lines.zh: 你把珍珠收好，我不抢了。
lines.en: Put the pearl away, and I will not take it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的牙还能咬人。
lines.en: A tooth that fell off can still bite.

lines.zh: 你捡走的是我散掉的一块。
lines.en: What you took is a piece that fell off me.

lines.zh: 那东西会蚀穿你的口袋。
lines.en: That thing will eat through your pocket.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我就当你聪明。
lines.en: Put it down and I will call you wise.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我要把那笑蚀掉。
lines.en: You smiled, and I mean to corrode that smile.

lines.zh: 你站在我同伴的尸骸边。
lines.en: You are standing by my kin's remains.

lines.zh: 你射了我一箭，箭化了，你还在。
lines.en: You shot me; the arrow dissolved, you did not.

lines.zh: 你的护甲让我想起那天的龙。
lines.en: Your armor reminds me of the dragon that day.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你躲得最远。
lines.en: I choose you because you hid the farthest.

lines.zh: 你手里提着龙息瓶，那就是证据。
lines.en: You carry a breath bottle; that is proof.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方还留着紫痕。
lines.en: Purple marks remain where you stepped.

lines.zh: 我要绕过你的甲，直接碰你。
lines.en: I mean to go around your armor and touch you.

lines.zh: 你身后有六个人，都算。
lines.en: There are six behind you, and all count.

lines.zh: 你抬头看末地门，我不喜欢那眼神。
lines.en: You glance at the End portal; I dislike that look.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我已经闻到了。
lines.en: Your breathing has changed; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我散开一点，堵住你的路。
lines.en: I spread a little and block your way.

lines.zh: 你跑向我同伴，他救不了你。
lines.en: Run to my kin; he cannot save you.

lines.zh: 锁定，雾开始往你那边偏。
lines.en: Locked; the mist begins drifting your way.

lines.zh: 我散成一片，把你的退路围住。
lines.en: I spread thin and close off your retreat.

lines.zh: 毒雾在慢慢铺，你不觉得吗。
lines.en: The poison mist is spreading; do you not feel it?

lines.zh: 我等你眨第二次眼。
lines.en: I am waiting for your second blink.

lines.zh: 你的甲最薄的地方在腋下。
lines.en: The thinnest point of your armor is the armpit.

lines.zh: 我故意漏出一声嘶，让你转身。
lines.en: I let out a hiss on purpose to turn you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴站在你左后，位置很好。
lines.en: Your friend stands at your left rear; good spot.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作很慢，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly, as if greeting.

lines.zh: 地面开始起泡，那是我的雾。
lines.en: The ground bubbles; that is my mist.

lines.zh: 你在算风向，雾不走风。
lines.en: You judge the wind, but mist ignores wind.

lines.zh: 我贴地铺开，你抬头看不见。
lines.en: I spread along the ground where your eyes do not go.

lines.zh: 你举盾护住正面，很好。
lines.en: You raise your shield to the front; good.

lines.zh: 我再散一点，空气就没了。
lines.en: A little more spreading and the air is gone.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在抖，我等它软下去。
lines.en: Your knees tremble, and I wait for them to fold.

lines.zh: 这一步之后，你就没地方退了。
lines.en: After this step you have nowhere left to go.

lines.zh: 我的雾在你脚边积成一摊。
lines.en: My mist pools around your feet.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你的甲，摸到皮肤。
lines.en: My hand passes through your armor to the skin.

lines.zh: 一抓下去，护甲没事，人烂了。
lines.en: One rake and the armor is fine while you rot.

lines.zh: 我吐出一小片龙息，你整片都疼。
lines.en: I spit a little breath and all of you burns.

lines.zh: 你砍我，刀从雾里穿过去。
lines.en: You cut me and the blade passes through mist.

lines.zh: 我的指尖在你颈侧留了三个孔。
lines.en: My fingertips leave three holes at your neck.

lines.zh: 腐蚀顺着你的锁骨往下走。
lines.en: The corrosion runs down along your collarbone.

lines.zh: 我抱住你，你的甲开始冒白烟。
lines.en: I hold you and your armor starts to smoke.

lines.zh: 你喊，声音被雾吞掉一半。
lines.en: You shout, and the mist swallows half of it.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的袖子，皮一起下来。
lines.en: I tear your sleeve off, skin with it.

lines.zh: 这一击不看护甲，只看你。
lines.en: This blow ignores armor and looks only at you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴拉你，也沾上了。
lines.en: Your friend pulls you and catches it too.

lines.zh: 我把雾吹进你的护面。
lines.en: I blow mist into your visor.

lines.zh: 你跪下时，膝盖先化了。
lines.en: When you kneel, your knees dissolve first.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，看你还在疼。
lines.en: I step back and watch you keep hurting.

lines.zh: 末影龙的一口息落在我身上。
lines.en: One breath of the ender dragon fell on me.

lines.zh: 我原本会传送，现在只会滴。
lines.en: I used to teleport; now I only drip.

lines.zh: 那道光打中我时，我还在搬方块。
lines.en: The light hit me while I was carrying a block.

lines.zh: 我从黑曜石柱下爬起来，少了半边脸。
lines.en: I rise from the obsidian pillar missing half my face.

lines.zh: 末地的空气把我泡成了这样。
lines.en: The air of the End soaked me into this.

lines.zh: 龙息没杀死我，只把我化开了。
lines.en: Dragon breath did not kill me; it only dissolved me.

lines.zh: 我在龙骸旁边凝起来，学会了恨。
lines.en: I thickened by the dragon's bones and learned hate.

lines.zh: 同伴们躲开我，我就自己走了。
lines.en: My kin avoided me, so I walked alone.

lines.zh: 传送失败，我留在了这里。
lines.en: My teleport failed and left me here.

lines.zh: 那口息穿过我的胸口，留下一个孔。
lines.en: That breath went through my chest and left a hole.

lines.zh: 我出生时，脚下已经是一片焦土。
lines.en: When I formed, the ground below was already scorched.

lines.zh: 是龙先动的手。
lines.en: The dragon struck first.

lines.zh: 我从紫色的雨里站起来。
lines.en: I stand up out of a purple rain.

lines.zh: 别问我原来长什么样，忘了。
lines.en: Do not ask what I looked like before; I forgot.

lines.zh: 龙息落到地上，把我从土里泡起来。
lines.en: Dragon breath hit the ground and steeped me out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我从一摊紫液里抬起头。
lines.en: I raise my head out of a pool of violet.

lines.zh: 火一碰，我就化成一片紫烟往上飘。
lines.en: Fire touches me and I rise as purple smoke.

lines.zh: 落地时我散成雾，好一会儿才聚回人形。
lines.en: I scatter on landing and take a while to re-form.

lines.zh: 水冲淡了我，我快要认不出自己。
lines.en: Water thins me until I barely know myself.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我打散，碎雾里全是嘶声。
lines.en: The blast breaks me apart; the mist is all hissing.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，只在雾里留下一条道。
lines.en: The arrow passes and leaves a lane through the mist.

lines.zh: 魔法想固定我的形状，我拒绝了。
lines.en: Magic tries to fix my shape, and I refuse.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体一直在饿。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet this body is always hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我亮了一瞬，又暗了。
lines.en: Lightning lands on me; I flash once and dim.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拉散，这次大概聚不回来。
lines.en: The void pulls me apart, likely for good this time.
